Sanitized public metadata HTML captured 2026-09-13 with three anonymous GETs. catalog.html preserves genre navigation, the first two catalog cards, and pagination from https://novel.naver.com/best/genre?genre=102. detail.html retains only work metadata, keywords, and the declared episode-count heading from https://novel.naver.com/best/list?novelId=1161705; no episode body was requested or retained. ranking.html retains the first two explicit ranks in each free/paid board from https://novel.naver.com/best/ranking?genre=102&periodType=DAILY. Scripts, inputs, buttons and event handlers were removed. Tests create additional malformed/empty cases in memory.
